tech_stack_overview.name: Genkit Tech Stack Overview
tech_stack_overview.description: Genkit uses a comprehensive technology stack: React and HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript for frontend, Python (FastAPI, Django), Node.js, and Java for backend microservices, MySQL, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL for relational and NoSQL databases, and Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, and After Effects for UI/UX and graphic design.

backend.name: Python
backend.description: Primary language for AI pipelines, scraping scripts, and web services using FastAPI/Django.

backend.name: FastAPI
backend.description: Used for building modern, high-performance, and asynchronous APIs.

backend.name: Django
backend.description: Utilized for complex, database-heavy web applications with robust admin interfaces.

backend.name: Node.js
backend.description: Powers real-time messaging applications and server-side APIs using Express.

backend.name: Java
backend.description: Deploys enterprise-grade microservices and secure transaction systems.

frontend.name: React
frontend.description: Creates highly interactive, component-based single-page user interfaces.

frontend.name: HTML5 & CSS3
frontend.description: Structural and styling foundations for all responsive, modern layouts.

frontend.name: JavaScript
frontend.description: Provides scripting logic and DOM manipulations across client browsers.

databases.name: MySQL
databases.description: Reliable relational database for transactional consistency and structured tables.

databases.name: MongoDB
databases.description: NoSQL document storage for flexible, schema-less configurations and dynamic payloads.

databases.name: PostgreSQL
databases.description: Advanced open-source database with robust JSON querying and geometric data support.

creative_tools.name: Figma
creative_tools.description: Standard software for vector wireframing, UI design, and interactive prototypes.

creative_tools.name: Adobe Photoshop
creative_tools.description: Used for graphic edits, image compositions, and social media flyers.

creative_tools.name: Adobe Illustrator
creative_tools.description: Deploys scalable vector graphics, brand logos, business cards, and typography layouts.

creative_tools.name: Adobe Premiere Pro
creative_tools.description: Primary toolkit for timeline video edits, audio mixing, and multi-track logs.

creative_tools.name: Adobe After Effects
creative_tools.description: Powers complex kinetic typography, motion graphics, transitions, and logo animations.
